metadata.description: OLF post-signature obligation & renewal management for Claude Cowork. Obligation-first, draft-only.

plugins.name: olf-obligation-manager
plugins.description: Extracts living obligations from executed contracts into a register, computes diary dates, and runs a compliance sweep that posts a due-dates digest to the internal OLF team Slack channel. HTML dashboard console. Internal reminders may post; outbound to clients stays draft-only.
